chapter_seo_title: Han Li Chooses Spirit Stones Over Sect Aid – RMJI Chapter 367
chapter_meta_description: After being slapped and offered two paths to repay his rescue, Han Li makes a surprising choice that leaves Nan Gong Ping stunned. A lesson in Mortal Stream pragmatism.
og_title: Han Li Chooses Spirit Stones Over Sect Aid – Chapter 367
og_description: After two slaps and a choice between spirit stones and a sect-guaranteed recovery, Han Li picks freedom. A cold calculation of debt and survival.
twitter_title: Han Li gets slapped twice, then picks spirit stones over a cushy sect life. Classic.
twitter_description: Han Li surprises Nan Gong Ping by rejecting her generous second offer and opting for a pile of spirit stones instead. Mortal Stream thinking at its finest.

lore_anchors.definition: A Core Formation cultivator of the Moon-Masking Sect, Nan Gong Wan’s cousin. Cold, proud, and bound by a strict code of repayment despite her harsh demeanor.

A semi-suicidal Moon-Masking Sect technique that, when activated by a cultivator whose true essence is severely depleted, automatically drains the true essence of anyone who probes her with spiritual power.
A high-grade white jade used in repairing ancient teleportation arrays; valued for its ability to stabilize spatial fluctuations.
A cultivation partnership—often but not always involving physical intimacy—aimed at accelerating mutual progress through shared energy circulation and alchemical exchange.
A standard currency and energy source in the cultivation world; one mid-grade spirit stone is worth approximately one hundred low-grade spirit stones.
